title: OWASP Agentic AI Top 10: what it uses
lede: One arrow for each component this feature lists. The steps reuse the feature's own "how it works" text; nothing here is a new claim. Internal and confidential: this text comes from an internal Ping deck and has not been tested on our tenant.

steps.title: AIGuard content inspection
steps.what: The slide maps the ten ASI categories to controls across the platform, some by AIGuard content inspection and others by the gateway's architectural controls: a chokepoint every agent must pass, scoped and instantly revocable credentials, and enforced spend ceilings.
steps.why: Security review now demands precise answers against the OWASP Agentic Security Initiative (ASI) taxonomy.
